title: Black Budget
description: Recover the invoices that keep the vacancy funded.
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: Three competitors pay the same unseen administrator.

lore.title: Black Budget / Unsent message
lore.text: ORIN / Directorate defector: Recover the invoices that keep the vacancy funded. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Black Budget / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Black Budget: Three competitors pay the same unseen administrator. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Black Budget / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under black-budget: Three competitors pay the same unseen administrator. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: Three competitors pay the same unseen administrator.
